svg.aria-label: Restrict any app: User and system apps, by group or by single hook, and new apps as soon as they are installed.; Fake values: IMEI, Android ID, location, time zone and more; new each boot and different per app.; Activity: Every restricted call of each app, with the real and the fake value.; Your own hooks: Edit, import and export hook definitions, or write your own in Lua.; Downloads: Extra definitions that come with Doppel, like more analytics SDKs and a domain firewall.; Settings: Backup and restore, themes, accent colors and app icons. Multi-user, free and open source.
